mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 8.0 and remains below for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC drops below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals weakening household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns remain positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the previous year's level signals supply-side stress, which raises input costs and lowers margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 25 basis point or greater increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) within a month signals a tightening stance, raising borrowing costs and discount rates, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by 0.25% or more in one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8% and a fall in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 100,000 in the same month signals severe labor market stress, which reduces earnings and consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a broad-based demand collapse, which depresses earnings and equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained period (three consecutive months) where the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains above 5% signals a restrictive monetary policy regime, which increases discount rates and reduces growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS remains above 5.0% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01.
